q: Which hair diffuser works best for curly hair?
answer: Reviews disagree on the Hair Dryer Diffuser for Most Blowdryers Curly Wavy Hair Natu: one reviewer says airflow is weak and drying curly hair takes much longer [1], while another says it dried curly hair fast in about 15 minutes versus an hour with a bowl diffuser [2]. The Collapsible Hair Diffuser by The Curly Co. gets positive curly-hair feedback, drying hair quickly with next to no frizz [3] and working well for travel [4]. The Xtava Verona is praised as a diffuser/hairdryer combo for wavy-to-curly hair [5], though one curly-haired reviewer only confirms it dries hair and criticizes its button placement [6].

claims.text: The Hair Dryer Diffuser for Most Blowdryers Curly Wavy Hair Natu has weak airflow and takes much longer to dry curly hair.
The same diffuser dried curly hair fast, about 15 minutes versus an hour with a bowl diffuser.
The Collapsible Hair Diffuser by The Curly Co. dried hair quickly with next to no frizz.
The Collapsible Hair Diffuser by The Curly Co. worked well for travel.
The Xtava Verona is praised as a diffuser/hairdryer combo for wavy-to-curly hair.
A curly-haired reviewer says the Xtava Verona dries hair but has poorly placed buttons/switches.

q: Which beard trimmer is easiest to clean?
answer: The Electric Razor for Men 5 in 1 Rechargeable Electric Shaver B is described as easy to clean [7]. The Philips Norelco T970 Accu-Vac reviews mention a vacuum that catches about 2/3 of hairs [1] and reduces mess [2], but neither directly addresses ease of cleaning. No review directly compares cleaning ease between the two, so the 5 in 1 is the only one explicitly called easy to clean.

claims.text: The Electric Razor for Men 5 in 1 Rechargeable Electric Shaver B is described as easy to clean.
The Philips Norelco T970 Accu-Vac has a vacuum that catches about 2/3 of hairs and reduces mess.

q: Which eyebrow pen lasts all day without smudging?
answer: The Vanelc Eyebrow Tattoo Pen is described as not bleeding, smearing, or fading [1]. The AFY eyebrow pencil is said to stay on [5] and last even overnight [6]. The 4 Point Eyebrow Pen stayed clear and crisp overnight on a hand test [7], though another reviewer found it barely dispensed color [8].

claims.text: The Vanelc Eyebrow Tattoo Pen does not bleed, smear, or fade.
The AFY eyebrow pencil stays on and lasts even overnight.
The 4 Point Eyebrow Pen stayed clear and crisp overnight on a hand test.
Another reviewer found the 4 Point Eyebrow Pen barely dispensed color.

q: Which shower cap keeps long hair dry?
answer: The Reusable Shower Cap for Women – Leakproof, Nonslip Hair Cap keeps long hair dry, with one reviewer noting their hair stays dry despite a keratin treatment [1] and another with nearly waist-length hair saying their hair doesn't get wet at all [2]. The Joemoon Long Hair Shower Cap is also described as keeping all hair dry [4] and holding long hair in while showering [3]. The 4Pcs Shower Caps work for shoulder-length hair [7] but may be too tight for very long hair [7][8].

claims.text: The Reusable Shower Cap for Women keeps long hair dry, including for a reviewer with a keratin treatment.
A reviewer with nearly waist-length hair says their hair doesn't get wet at all with the Reusable Shower Cap for Women.
The Joemoon Long Hair Shower Cap holds long hair in while showering.
The Joemoon Long Hair Shower Cap keeps all hair dry.
The 4Pcs Shower Caps fit snugly for shoulder-length hair but may be too tight for very long hair.

q: Which curling iron holds curls longest?
answer: The 3 Barrel Curling Iron Wand TEATTY Hair Waver is reported to hold curls all day, even on fine, straight hair [4]. The inkint Mini Curling Iron also kept curls for a long time [5]. By contrast, the Hair Waver, Beach Curls Curling Iron did not hold curls as long as expected [8].

claims.text: The 3 Barrel Curling Iron Wand TEATTY Hair Waver held curls all day on fine, straight hair [4].
The inkint Mini Curling Iron kept curls for a long time [5].
The Hair Waver, Beach Curls Curling Iron did not hold curls as long as expected [8].
